title: Glass Break
description: YOU CAN CRAFT PUNCH GLASS SAFELY!
body:
**_Glass Break_**

Glass Break is a simple vanilla-friendly Minecraft datapack that improves glass-related gameplay.

**Features**

* Break glass without losing all of its value.
* New crafting recipes involving glass blocks and glass panes.
* Makes glass resources more useful and less wasteful.
* Works in survival mode.
* No mods required.

**Why use this datapack?**

In vanilla Minecraft, glass can sometimes feel expensive and unforgiving to use. Glass Break adds quality-of-life improvements that make glass building more enjoyable while keeping the vanilla experience balanced.

Perfect for builders, survival players, and anyone who wants more practical uses for glass without installing mods.

**How to use?**

Download the pack, copy or cut the pack, go to C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\saves\WORLDNAME\datapacks
and paste the pack.
